description: This file defines the BreakpointManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing breakpoint plugins, including loading definitions, caching, grouping, and providing breakpoint instances.

classes.name: BreakpointManager
classes.description: A plugin manager class for handling breakpoints in Drupal, including loading, caching, grouping, and instantiating breakpoint plugins.

methods.name: getDiscovery
methods.description: Returns the plugin discovery object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: processDefinition
methods.description: Processes each plugin definition, ensuring default values and sorting multipliers.

methods.name: providerExists
methods.description: Checks if a provider module or theme exists.

methods.name: getBreakpointsByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves breakpoint instances grouped by a specific group, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns all breakpoint groups with labels, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getGroupProviders
methods.description: Returns providers for a specific breakpoint group.

methods.name: clearCachedDefinitions
methods.description: Clears cached plugin definitions and related data.

methods.name: getGroupLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for a given breakpoint group, handling extension and theme names or translatable labels.
